name: io.github.tonbistudio/agentwikis-mcp
title: Agent Wikis
description: Maintained, agent-readable knowledge bases with calibrated search and provenance. Pro key adds XL.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWIKIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Agent Wikis instance to query. Defaults to https://agentwikis.com; set to point at a self-hosted/private instance.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWIKIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent Wikis Pro API key. When set, open_wiki, search, and read_document include the Pro (XL) tier; without it the server serves the free tier only.
